description_en: Updates information about a face group in a media set, such as the name, cover image, and tags
description_zh: 更新媒体集中人脸分组的名称、封面图、标签等信息
kebab_example: aliyun imm update-face-group --project immimagetest --set-id set001 --group-id Group-c5fdad70-fd60-4c2a-8a08-ed86aca21f09 --api-version 2017-09-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateFaceGroup

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the media set
parameters.name: set_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the face group
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the face group
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en:
The FaceId of the cover image for the face group. You can obtain the FaceId by calling media set image processing operations such as GetImage and ListImages.

The FaceId must be the ID of a face in the same group (that is, the same GroupId)
parameters.help_zh:
人脸分组封面图的FaceId，可以使用媒体集图片处理相关接口（例如GetImage、ListImages等）获得该FaceId。

FaceId必须为同一分组 （即GroupId相同）中的人脸ID
parameters.name: group_cover_face_id
